meta.period: Residential through September 2026; rates as of October 16, 2026
meta.coverage: SE Florida (Miami-Dade, Broward, Palm Beach, Martin, St. Lucie) + statewide FL
meta.disclaimer: Figures compiled from public market reports (Florida Realtors, MIAMI Realtors, CBRE, Freddie Mac, FL OIR) and are informational only - not investment, tax, or financial advice. Deemed reliable but not guaranteed.
meta.note_source: County residential metrics are pulled monthly from the MIAMI REALTORS + RWorld county statistics releases (miamirealtors.com, MIAMI MLS + BeachesMLS), published ~the 16th-17th for the prior month; the statewide row comes from the Florida Realtors Monthly Market Summary (floridarealtors.org/newsroom/market-data). Note: as of September 2026 the Florida Realtors county report generator requires member login, so the public MIAMI REALTORS county releases are the county source. This replaced the RAPB-GFLR ShowingTime MMI as the residential source on 2026-07-23.

residential.source: September 2026. County rows: MIAMI REALTORS + RWorld September 2026 county statistics (released October 16, 2026; MIAMI MLS + BeachesMLS). Statewide row: Florida Realtors Monthly Market Summary, September 2026 (released October 16, 2026). Next release November 16, 2026.
residential.note: SF Median = single-family median sale price; Condo Median = townhouse/condo median sale price. Closed Sales YoY and Homes for Sale YoY are single-family, year-over-year.
